DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。公園の見学で何をお手伝いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. How can I help you explore the park?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 友人と一つの双眼鏡を使います。鳥を見る人と景色を見る人がいるので、立つ場所と交替を相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 友人と一つの双眼鏡で鳥や景色を見るため、立つ位置と交替の方法を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: My friend and I share one pair of binoculars. One wants to watch birds and the other scenery, so we would like advice on where to stand and taking turns.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask where to stand and how to take turns sharing binoculars with a friend to watch birds and scenery. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: どの場所で見る予定ですか。通行する方の妨げにはなりませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Where do you plan to watch? Would you obstruct people passing by?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 案内板の近くを考えましたが、人が止まるので横へ移りたいです。足元を見てから道具を使います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 案内板の近くは人が止まるので脇へ移り、足元を確認してから観察したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: We considered near the information board, but people stop there, so we want to move aside. We will check our footing before using the equipment.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that people stop near the information board, so you want to move aside and check your footing before observing. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 通路を空け、ご自身の安全な位置で観察してください。交替の合図は決めていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Keep the path clear and observe from a safe position. Have you agreed on a signal for taking turns?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 見終わったら声をかけて手渡します。友人が見ている時に、急に引いて景色の方へ向けません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 見終わって声をかけて手渡し、友人が見ている最中に双眼鏡を引いて向きを変えないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: We will say when we finish and hand them over. I will not suddenly pull the binoculars and point them toward the scenery while my friend is looking.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you will speak when finished and hand them over, without pulling the binoculars to change direction while your friend is looking. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 道具を安定して渡せる位置で交替しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Take turns from a position where you can hand the equipment over steadily.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 鳥が近くに来ても、近づいて追いかけるのはやめます。見える場所から静かに待ち、いなければ景色を見ます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 鳥が近づいても追いかけず、安全な場所で静かに待ち、いなければ景色を見ると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: Even if birds come close, I will not approach and chase them. We will wait quietly where we can see, and look at scenery if there are no birds.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will not chase birds even if they approach, will wait quietly in a safe place, and look at scenery if none are there. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 動物やほかの利用者に配慮して楽しんでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Enjoy yourselves while being considerate of animals and other visitors.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 通路を空け、声をかけて交替します。鳥を追わず、その場で見える物を二人で順に楽しみます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 通路を空けて声をかけて交替し、鳥を追わず二人で順にその場の景色を楽しむと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: We will leave the path clear and speak before taking turns. We will not chase birds and will enjoy what we can see there, one after the other.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will keep the path clear, speak before taking turns, and enjoy the view there in turn without chasing birds. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。周りに気をつけて、どうぞお楽しみください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Please be mindful of your surroundings and enjoy your visit.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。乗り換えについて何をお手伝いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. How can I help you with your transfer?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 北斗で乗り換える予定です。券が何枚かあるので、どの区間の物か整理してから進みたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 乗換えに使う券が何枚かあるので、区間ごとに整理してから移動したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: I plan to change trains in Hokuto. I have several tickets, so I want to sort them by travel section before proceeding.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you have several tickets for your transfer and want to sort them by travel section before moving on. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 予約の旅程と、すべての券を見せていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: Could you show me your booked itinerary and all the tickets?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 新幹線の予約と、その前に乗る列車の券があります。券の大きさだけで使う順番を決めないようにしたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 新幹線の予約とその前に乗る列車の券があり、券の大きさでは使用順を決めないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: I have a Shinkansen reservation and a ticket for the train before it. I want to avoid deciding the order of use based only on ticket size.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that you have the Shinkansen reservation and ticket for the preceding train and will not decide their order by ticket size. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 印字された区間や種類を担当と確認しましょう。予約はどなたの分ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let us check the printed sections and ticket types with the person in charge. Whom is the reservation for?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 私一人です。控えも混ざっているので、乗車に使う物と単なる記録を分けて見てほしいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 予約は自分一人分で控えも混ざっているため、乗車に使う券と記録だけの紙を分けてほしいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: Just me. There are receipts mixed in too, so I would like you to separate items used for travel from papers that are only records.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that the reservation is for you alone, with receipts mixed in, and ask to separate travel tickets from record-only papers. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 印字を見て分けました。こちらが前の区間の乗車券、次の二枚が新幹線区間の乗車券と特急券、最後が「申込控え」です。実際の乗換駅は旅程に何とありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: We sorted them by the print. This is the fare ticket for the first section; the next two are the fare ticket and limited-express ticket for the Shinkansen section; the last is the application receipt. What is the actual transfer station in your itinerary?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい、旅程には新函館北斗とあります。北斗という市の名前だけで駅を選ばず、予約の駅名と案内を照合します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 旅程の乗換駅は新函館北斗で、市名だけで駅を選ばず予約の正式名と案内を照合すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: The itinerary says Shin-Hakodate-Hokuto. I will compare the official station name in my reservation with the directions rather than choose a station based only on the city name Hokuto.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that the itinerary's transfer station is Shin-Hakodate-Hokuto and you will check the official reservation name against directions rather than choose by city name. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 新函館北斗ですね。申込控えは控えとして分け、新幹線区間の二枚は一緒に置きました。改札でどれを使うかは、券を担当に見せて確認してから進んでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Shin-Hakodate-Hokuto, then. We separated the application receipt and put the two Shinkansen tickets together. Before going through the gate, show your tickets to the person in charge to confirm which to use.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 前の区間の券、新幹線区間の二枚、申込控えに分かれました。旅程の乗換は新函館北斗です。控えを券と取り違えず、改札で使う組合せは担当に確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 前区間の券、新幹線区間の二枚、申込控えに分かれたと確認し、新函館北斗で改札に使う組合せを担当へ尋ねると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: They are now separated into the first-section ticket, two Shinkansen-section tickets, and the application receipt. My itinerary's transfer is Shin-Hakodate-Hokuto. I will not mistake the receipt for a ticket and will ask staff which combination to use at the gate.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm the separation into the first-section ticket, two Shinkansen tickets and application receipt, and say you will ask staff which combination to use at Shin-Hakodate-Hokuto's gate. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。担当へご案内します。お気をつけてお出かけください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. I will direct you to the person in charge. Travel safely.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。生活の相談で何をお手伝いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. How can I help you with everyday-life advice?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 説明が長くなってしまいます。住む所と仕事の予定について、何から話せばよいか整理したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 住まいと仕事の予定の説明が長くなるので、何から相談すればよいか整理したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: My explanations become too long. I want to organize what to say first about my housing and work plans.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that explanations of your housing and work plans become long and you want to organize which issue to discuss first. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 先に決まったことと、まだ決まっていないことを分けられますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Can you separate what is already decided from what is not?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 今の部屋を出る日は決まっています。新しい仕事の開始日はまだ決まっていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 今の部屋の退居日は決まったが、新しい仕事の開始日は未定だと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: The date I leave my current room is set. The start date of my new job is not decided yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that your move-out date is set but the new job's start date is undecided. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 確定した退居日から説明しましょう。次の住まいは用意できていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let us begin with the confirmed move-out date. Is your next home ready?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 候補はありますが契約はしていません。仕事が決まれば必ず住めると考えず、住居の相談もしたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 次の住まいは候補だけで未契約なので、仕事が決まれば必ず入居できるとは考えず住居も相談したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: I have an option but no signed contract. I do not assume getting the job guarantees I can move in, so I want housing advice too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you only have a housing option without a contract and want housing advice without assuming getting the job guarantees occupancy. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 住居と就労の相談先を確認します。退居日までの時間も担当へ知らせてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will check housing and employment advice contacts. Please also tell the person in charge how much time remains until you move out.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 退居日は10月8日です。仕事の話を先に長くして、住む所の期限が伝わらなくなるのは避けたいです。まずこの日を紙に書いてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 退居は10月8日と示し、仕事の長い説明で住居の期限が隠れないようまずその日を紙へ書いてほしいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: The move-out date is October 8. I want to avoid a long account of work hiding the housing deadline. Please write this date on paper first.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: State the October 8 move-out date and ask to write it first so a long work explanation does not obscure the housing deadline. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 一行目は「10月8日に退居・確定」、二行目は「次の住居は候補のみ・未契約」、三行目は「仕事の開始日・未定」と書きました。意味は合っていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: I wrote: first line, move out October 8, confirmed; second, next home only an option, no contract; third, job start date undecided. Is that accurate?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい、その三行で合っています。10月8日の退居期限から相談したいです。部屋も仕事日も決まったとは書かず、このメモを担当へ渡してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 三行の退居確定・新居未契約・仕事開始未定は合っていると確認し、10月8日の期限から担当へ相談したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes, those three lines are correct. I want advice starting with the October 8 deadline. Please give this note to the person in charge without writing that housing or the job date is settled.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm that the three lines correctly show confirmed move-out, unsigned housing and undecided job start, and say you want to discuss the October 8 deadline first. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。状況を担当へお伝えします。ご相談ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. I will convey your situation to the person in charge. Thank you for consulting us.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。予約のご相談で何をお手伝いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. How can I help you discuss your appointment?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 家族から予約変更の相談を頼まれました。本人の希望と、私が付き添える日を分けて伝えたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 家族に予約変更の相談を頼まれたので、本人の希望と自分の付き添い可能日を別に伝えたいと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: A family member asked me to discuss changing their appointment. I want to explain their preferences separately from the dates I can accompany them.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that a family member asked you to discuss changing an appointment and you want to separate their preferences from your accompaniment availability. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: ご本人は何を変更したいと話していますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: What does the person themselves say they want to change?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 本人は今の日時が仕事と重なるので変えたいそうです。私の都合だけで変更する話ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 本人の予約が仕事と重なるため変更を希望しており、付き添いの都合だけの変更ではないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: They say the current date and time conflict with work. This is not a change solely for my convenience.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that they want to change because the appointment conflicts with their work, not just for the companion's convenience. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: ご本人の希望日時や、確認できる連絡先はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Do you have their preferred dates and a way to contact them for confirmation?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 本人の希望は10月6日と8日です。私は8日しか付き添えませんが、本人は6日なら一人で行くことも相談したいと言っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 本人は10月6日と8日を希望し、自分は8日だけ付き添えるが本人は6日に一人で受診することも相談したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: They prefer October 6 or 8. I can accompany them only on the 8th, but they also want to discuss coming alone on the 6th.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that the person prefers October 6 or 8, you can accompany them only on the 8th, but they also want to discuss attending alone on the 6th. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 本人確認や変更の方法は担当へ確認します。二つの希望を、付き添いの条件で勝手に一つへ減らさないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will check identity verification and change procedures with the person in charge. Do not reduce their two preferences to one based on your availability.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 二日とも伝えます。私が行ける日は別に書き、私の返事だけで本人の予約を確定しません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 希望二日を両方伝え、付き添い可能日は別に示し、自分の返事だけで予約を確定しないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will state both dates. I will list my available date separately and will not confirm their appointment based only on my own reply.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will state both preferred dates, show accompaniment availability separately, and not confirm the appointment on your reply alone. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 記録を読み返します。本人の希望は6日と8日の二つ、付き添いが可能なのは8日のみ。6日の希望も削っていません。ご本人への確認と変更日は、担当の回答待ちです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: I will read back the record. Their preferences are the 6th and 8th; accompaniment is possible only on the 8th. We have not removed the 6th. Confirmation with the person themselves and the changed date await the staff's reply.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: その分け方で合っています。本人の6日と8日を残し、私が行けるのは8日だけと別にしてください。私の返事だけで8日に確定せず、本人と担当の確認を待ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 本人の希望6日と8日、付き添いは8日のみという読み返しを確認し、自分の返事だけで8日に確定せず本人と担当の確認を待つと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: That separation is correct. Please retain both the 6th and 8th for them and separately note that I can go only on the 8th. Do not settle on the 8th based on my answer alone; I will wait for confirmation from them and the staff.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm the readback of the person's preferences for the 6th and 8th and accompaniment only on the 8th. Say you will not confirm the 8th solely on your reply and will await the person's and staff's confirmation. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。担当へおつなぎします。ご相談ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. I will connect you with the person in charge. Thank you for consulting us.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。どのようなことでお手伝いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. How can I help you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 手帳を拾いました。名前を探して少し開いたら仕事の資料らしい物があったので、ここへ届けたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 拾った手帳を名前の確認で少し開いたら仕事の資料があり、窓口へ届けたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: I found a planner. I opened it a little to look for a name and saw what looked like work documents, so I want to hand it in here.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you opened a found planner slightly to look for a name, saw work documents, and want to hand it in at the desk. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: どこで、いつ拾いましたか。いま手帳はお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Where and when did you find it? Do you have it now?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 歩道で先ほどです。手帳はかばんに入れ、閉じた状態で持ってきました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 先ほど歩道で拾い、閉じた状態でかばんに入れて持参したと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: On the sidewalk a little while ago. I put it in my bag and brought it closed.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you found it on the sidewalk a little while ago and brought it closed inside your bag. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: そのままお預かりの確認をします。資料の内容を撮影したり、誰かへ送ったりしましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: We will check the handover as it is. Did you photograph the documents or send them to anyone?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: していません。連絡先を探し続けるのはやめ、名前があっても自分で公開しないようにしました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 中身は撮影も送信もせず、連絡先を探し続けたり名前を公開したりしていないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: No. I stopped looking for contact details and made sure not to publish any name even if I found one.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you neither photographed nor sent the contents, did not continue searching for contacts, and did not publish a name. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 拾った場所と、開いた経緯を担当へ説明してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please explain where you found it and why you opened it to the person in charge.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 最初のページだけ見ました。読めなかった部分を推測せず、どこまで見たかそのまま伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 見たのは最初のページだけで、読めない部分を推測せず開いた範囲をそのまま説明すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: I looked only at the first page. I will explain exactly how much I saw without guessing the parts I could not read.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you saw only the first page and will describe how much you opened without guessing unreadable parts. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 他人の資料を広げず、担当へ手帳ごとお渡しください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please hand the entire planner to the person in charge without spreading out someone else's documents.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 拾った場所と時刻、最初のページを開いたことを説明します。中身は撮らず送らず、閉じたまま渡します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 拾得場所と時刻、最初のページを開いた経緯を示し、中身を撮影も送信もせず閉じて渡すと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will explain the place and time I found it and that I opened the first page. I will hand it over closed without photographing or sending the contents.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Describe the finding location and time and why you opened the first page, and say you will hand it over closed without photographing or sending the contents. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。お届けありがとうございます。担当が確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Thank you for handing it in. The person in charge will check it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。発送のことで何をお手伝いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. How can I help you with your shipment?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 友人への贈り物を送ります。驚かせたくて説明していませんが、知らない荷物だと困るかもしれないので相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 予告していない贈り物を友人へ送るので、知らない荷物として困らないか相談したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: I am sending a gift to a friend. I have not told them because I wanted it to be a surprise, but an unexpected parcel may cause difficulty, so I would like advice.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you are sending an unannounced gift to a friend and want advice about whether an unfamiliar parcel could cause difficulty. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 友人は受取りができる予定ですか。送り先は本人に確認しましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Will your friend be able to receive it? Have you confirmed the address with them?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 前に聞いた住所です。最近引っ越したかもしれないので、今の受取先を先に確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 以前聞いた住所だが最近転居した可能性があるため、現在の受取先を先に確認すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: It is an address they told me before. They may have moved recently, so I will check their current delivery address first.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that you have an old address but your friend may have moved, so you will check the current delivery address first. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 現在の宛先で準備しましょう。中身を詳しく言わず、荷物を送ることは伝えられますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please prepare it for the current address. You can tell them you are sending a parcel without describing its contents in detail.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 贈り物だと伝え、受け取れる日を聞きます。驚かせるために差出人を他の人の名前にしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 贈り物だと知らせて受取予定を聞き、驚かせるため別人の差出人名は使わないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will say it is a gift and ask when they can receive it. I will not use someone else's sender name to surprise them.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you will tell them it is a gift and ask about receiving it, without using a different sender name to surprise them. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ご自身の差出人情報で準備してください。中身の発送条件も確認できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please use your own sender details. We can also check shipping conditions for the contents.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 壊れやすい飾りです。箱の中で動かないようにし、取扱いの案内を聞いてから封をします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 中身は壊れやすい飾りなので箱内で動かないよう準備し、取扱いを聞いてから封をすると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: It is a fragile ornament. I will secure it so it does not move inside the box and ask about handling before sealing it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that it is a fragile ornament, you will keep it from moving in the box, and ask about handling before sealing it. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 梱包と宛先を確認してお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please check the packaging and address before bringing it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 友人へ発送予定を知らせ、今の住所と受取予定を確かめます。自分の名前で、飾りの梱包を確認して送ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 発送予定、現住所、受取予定を友人に確認し、自分の名前で梱包を確かめて送ると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will tell my friend the shipping plan and confirm their current address and availability to receive it. I will send it in my own name after checking the ornament's packaging.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will confirm the shipping plan, current address and receiving availability with your friend, check the packaging, and send under your own name. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。準備ができましたらご相談ください。ありがとうございます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Please consult us when it is ready. Thank you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。口座の相談で何をお手伝いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. How can I help you with your account?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 給与の口座を変えたいです。会社へ新しい情報を出したら、旧口座をすぐ使わなくしてよいか確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 給与口座を変えるので、会社へ新情報を出したら旧口座をすぐ使わなくしてよいか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: I want to change my salary account. I would like to check whether I may stop using the old account immediately after giving my employer the new details.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether you may stop using your old account immediately after giving your employer new salary-account details. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 勤務先から、切り替える給与の月を案内されていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Has your employer told you which month's salary will switch?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: まだです。提出した次の日から変わると思わず、会社に確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 切替月はまだ案内されておらず、提出翌日から変わるとは判断せず会社に確認すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: Not yet. I will check with the company rather than assume it changes the day after I submit the information.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that the switch month has not been provided and you will check with the company without assuming it changes the next day. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 給与の切替えは勤務先へ、口座の手続きは担当へ確認しましょう。旧口座にほかの取引はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Check the salary switch with your employer and account procedures with the person in charge. Are there other transactions in the old account?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 公共料金が残っています。給与が変わることだけで、ほかの支払いも変わるわけではないと整理します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 旧口座には公共料金の支払いもあり、給与の変更だけで全支払いが切り替わるわけではないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: Utility payments remain. I understand changing the salary account does not automatically change the other payments.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that utility payments also use the old account and a salary-account change does not switch all payments. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 各取引の変更方法と時期を確認してください。現在の取引記録を見ながら整理できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please check the method and timing for changing each transaction. You can organize them using current transaction records.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 支払い先の一覧を作ります。新口座への変更済みと、まだ申し込んでいないものを分けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 支払先一覧を作り、新口座への変更済みと未申込みの取引を分けると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will make a list of payees, separating those already changed to the new account from those I have not applied to change.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will list payees and separate transactions already changed to the new account from those not yet applied for. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 切替えの確認前に旧口座の扱いを決めないよう、担当へご相談ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Consult the person in charge so you do not decide what to do with the old account before confirming the switch.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 会社へ給与の切替月を聞き、公共料金もそれぞれ確認します。旧口座は残る取引がわかってから担当へ相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 会社に給与の切替月を聞き、公共料金も個別に確認して、残る取引を把握してから旧口座の扱いを相談すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will ask my employer which salary month changes and check each utility individually. I will consult about the old account after understanding which transactions remain.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will ask the employer about the salary switch month, check utilities individually, and consult about the old account after identifying remaining transactions. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。担当へご案内します。ご相談ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. I will direct you to the person in charge. Thank you for consulting us.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。買い物で何をお手伝いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. How can I help you with shopping?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 同居人から食材の写真が届きました。欲しい物はわかりますが、いくつ買うかまだ聞いていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 同居人から食材の写真は届いたが数量は未確認なので、必要量を確かめたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: My housemate sent a photo of an ingredient. I know what they want but have not yet asked how many to buy.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you received an ingredient photo from your housemate but have not confirmed quantity and want to check how much is needed. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 品名は確認できますか。作る料理や人数はわかりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Can you confirm the product name? Do you know the dish and number of people?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 品名はこの表示です。いつもの二人分か、客も来るのかがわからないので、今聞いています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 写真で品名は分かるが、普段の二人分か来客もあるか不明で同居人へ問い合わせていると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: The name is on this label. I do not know whether it is for the usual two people or guests too, so I am asking now.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that the photo identifies the product but you are asking your housemate whether it is for the usual two people or includes guests. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 数量が決まるまで、写真の見た目だけで多く選ばずに確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let us confirm rather than choose a large quantity based only on the photo before the amount is decided.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 返事が来て、今日は四人だそうです。レシピで一人分の量も確認して、必要な材料を整理します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 今日は四人との返事があり、レシピで一人分も確認して必要な材料量を整理すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: A reply arrived: four people today. I will also check the recipe's amount per person and organize the ingredients needed.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that the reply says four people today and you will check the recipe's per-person quantity to work out the required ingredients. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 料理に必要な材料と量を整理できますね。同じ食材が家に残っていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Then you can organize the ingredients and quantities for the dish. Is any of the same ingredient left at home?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 少しあるそうです。家の分を使えるか確認してから、足りない量だけ買いたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 同じ食材が家に少し残るため、使えるか確認して不足する量だけ買いたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: Apparently a little. I want to check whether it can be used and buy only the shortfall.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that a little of the same ingredient remains at home, so you want to confirm it is usable and buy only what is lacking. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 使う分と追加する分を分けて選びましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Choose by separating the amount you will use from stock and the amount to add.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 四人の料理に必要な量と家の残りを同居人へ聞きます。写真の品名を確認し、足りない分だけ買います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 四人分に必要な量と使える在庫を同居人に聞き、写真の品名を照合して足りない分だけ買うと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will ask my housemate how much the meal for four needs and how much remains at home. I will verify the photographed product name and buy only what is lacking.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will ask your housemate the amount needed for four and usable stock, match the photographed product name, and buy only the shortfall. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。必要な量が決まりましたらお選びください。ありがとうございます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Please choose once you know the quantity needed. Thank you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。公園のご案内で何をお手伝いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. How can I help you with park information?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 散策した道を友人へ説明したいです。写真が似ていて場所を思い出せないので、記録の付け方を相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 散策した道を友人に伝えたいが似た写真で場所が分からず、記録の付け方を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I want to describe my walking route to a friend. The photos look similar and I cannot remember the locations, so I would like advice on keeping records.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask how to record your walking route for a friend because similar photos make it hard to identify locations. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 今いる場所は案内図で確認できますか。写真を撮った順は残っていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Can you locate where you are now on the map? Is the photo order preserved?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 案内図で現在地はわかります。写真の順はありますが、同じ木が何枚もあるので、それだけで場所を決められません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 現在地は案内図で分かり写真の順も残るが、同じ木の写真だけでは位置を決められないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: I can locate myself on the map and have the photo order. But there are several photos of the same tree, so that alone does not identify the places.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that the map shows your current position and the photo order is preserved, but photos of the same tree alone cannot determine locations. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 現在の目印と撮影順を分けて書けます。歩いた道がわからない部分は無理に埋めないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: You can record current landmarks separately from photo order. Please do not force yourself to fill in route sections you do not know.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 今の案内板の名前をメモします。前の写真の場所は未確認とし、歩いていない道を通ったことにしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 現在の案内板名を記録し、以前の写真の場所は未確認として歩いていない道を追加しないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will note the name of this information board. I will mark earlier photo locations unconfirmed and not add paths I did not walk.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you will record the current information board's name, mark earlier photo locations unconfirmed, and not add paths you did not walk. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 友人には、確認した経路と未確認の部分を区別して伝えましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Tell your friend which route sections are confirmed and which are not.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: もう一度歩くなら、止まって目印を書きます。歩きながら画面だけ見て、足元を見失わないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 再び歩く時は止まって目印を記録し、歩きながら画面だけを見続けないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: If I walk it again, I will stop to note landmarks. I will not keep looking only at the screen while walking and lose sight of my footing.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that on another walk you will stop to record landmarks rather than keep looking only at the screen while walking. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 安全な場所で記録してください。通路をふさがず、周りにも配慮しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please record from a safe place. Do not block the path and be considerate of others.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 案内板名と写真の順を記録し、不明な区間はそのまま伝えます。立ち止まって安全に確認してから歩きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 案内板名と撮影順を記録して不明な区間は不明とし、安全な場所で確認してから歩くと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will record the information board's name and photo order, and leave unknown sections as unknown. I will stop to check safely before walking.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will record the information board name and photo order, keep unclear sections unknown, and check in a safe place before walking. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。景色を楽しみながら、気をつけてお進みください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01236-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Enjoy the scenery and proceed carefully.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。何かお困りですか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 降りた列車に袋を忘れたかもしれません。列車へ戻る前に相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 降車した列車に袋を忘れた可能性があり、戻る前に相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: I may have left a bag on the train I got off. I would like to ask before going back to the train.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask for help before returning because you may have left a bag on the train you got off. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 列車はもう発車しました。何時ごろ到着した列車ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: The train has already departed. About what time did it arrive?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 五分ほど前です。前から二両目の窓側に座っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 到着は五分前で、前から二両目の窓側にいたと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: About five minutes ago. I was sitting by a window in the second carriage from the front.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that the train arrived about five minutes ago and you were by a window in the second carriage from the front. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 袋の特徴と、降りる時に見たかを教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please describe the bag and tell us whether you saw it when getting off.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 白い布の袋で青い弁当箱が入っています。降りる時は確認していません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 白い布の袋と青い弁当箱を説明し、降車時は未確認だと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: It is a white cloth bag containing a blue lunch box. I did not check when getting off.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Describe the white cloth bag and blue lunch box and say you did not check when getting off. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 車内へ照会します。ご自身の手荷物にも入っていないか確認できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will inquire on the train. Could you also check whether it is among your own luggage?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: かばんを見ましたがありません。まだ改札の内側で待っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: かばんにも見当たらず、まだ改札内で待っていると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: I checked my bag, but it is not there. I am still waiting inside the ticket gates.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that it is not in your bag and you are still waiting inside the ticket gates. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 係員から折返しを待っています。列車を追わず、こちらの待合せ場所でお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: We are waiting for staff to call back. Please do not chase the train; wait at this meeting place.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ここで待ちます。まだ発見されたとは考えず、返事を聞いてから受取り方法を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 指定場所で返事を待ち、発見を前提にせず結果を聞いて受取り方法を確認すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will wait here. I will not assume it has been found, but will hear the response before asking how to collect it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will wait for the response at the designated place, not assume it has been found, and ask about collection after hearing the result. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい、照会の返事が来たらお声がけします。ご相談ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Yes, we will let you know when the inquiry response arrives. Thank you for consulting us.
